forecast.expected_rule: Four replications of each measured seed42 CPUTimeRAW; pilot cost includes all allocations.
forecast.hard_rule: max(3, ceil((2 * measured collector wall seconds + 60) / 60)) per arm/maze; use the maximum across the five arms for each twenty-job maze array.
forecast.limitation: One cost seed does not bound other seeds. All attempts, used allocations and remaining hard reservations remain charged before each submission.

analysis.pooling: Concatenate blocks, retain recorded pair weights, normalize by their total (equal block mass). Same full pair universe for every arm.
analysis.fallback: Exclude random first-decision fallbacks from F, M and both D rates; retain them in C, random reference, value errors and fallback rate. Also export eligible-set C and random reference post hoc to reveal selection bias.
analysis.ceiling: Within each start take the maximum weighted optimal-action coverage, then sum over starts and divide by total pair weight.
analysis.discrimination: Unordered distinct goals at the same start, disjoint optimal-action sets, product of the two pair weights; pool numerator and denominator across starts. Export different-action and both-optimal rates; D in registered contrasts means different-action rate.
analysis.winner: For the chosen action retain all matching change-anticipating classifiers tied at the global maximum of fitness*numerosity. Equal fractional credit per tied macroclassifier, the conditional expectation under the existing uniform shuffle; fallbacks have no winner. The registered profile is unconditional over all first decisions: fallbacks contribute zero. Also report conditional on a nonfallback decision, and solved/failed denominators.
analysis.value_metric: mean estimate - Q* on all pairs at the final point, same fixed pair set and weights for every arm
analysis.missing: Undefined rates remain null with their denominators. Never drop seeds or impute; an inferential contrast with any undefined seed is undefined with the available count.
analysis.consistency: For each fixed pair at the final point count solved seeds 0..5. Descriptive plug-in Binomial(5,p), p=k/5 per pair; sum expected bin masses with pair weights. This reuses the same five outcomes to estimate p and is not an independent goodness-of-fit test.

identity: Every seed43--46 row must reproduce its frozen historical trajectory in all deterministic fields outside per-pair records, IEEE754 binary64 bits. Only grid_identity.OMIT provenance/time/arm fields are excluded. STOP on any mismatch.
ground_truth: Public acs2-envs MazeTopology transitions, including wall self-loops; reward 1000, gamma .95. Immediate arrival pays 1000; otherwise .95 times shortest-path successor value with cap-1. V*=0 beyond cap. All actions tie when no capped route is possible. Validate every recorded distance and Bellman maximum before analysis.

execution.source: Pinned clean measurement commit and frozen static binary; immutable operations snapshots.
execution.grouping: Six twenty-job arrays, one per maze: five arms times four seeds. At most two streams and forty running jobs. No dependent queue of future arrays.
execution.admission: Mechanically derive exact manifests from this registration before every sbatch; read grant and shared queue; sbatch --test-only. Pilot + used + reserved + new hard limits must fit the explicitly approved cumulative CPU-hour limit.
execution.scope: One accounting scope over pilot and replication, zero pilot offset, every attempt charged once.
execution.failure: Node identity guards and shared STOP on real failure; diagnose before recovery and preserve every failed attempt.

authorization: Stage1 complete after registration and external report. Seeds43--46 require explicit approval of these exact plan bytes and a cumulative CPU-hour limit; no stage2 allocations are authorized yet.
